contract.description: Return the signed heading of vector (dx, dy) in degrees: compute atan2(dy, dx), multiply by 180, then divide by pi.
contract.domain: All numeric arguments are finite and between -1000 and 1000 unless a tighter bound is stated. Inputs do not contain negative zero.
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
